verified_hardware: Base M4 MacBook Pro, 10 CPU cores, 10 GPU cores, 24 GiB memory
unverified_hardware: M1/M2/M3/M4 Pro/Max/Ultra/M5, iMac, Mac mini, and other configurations
campaign.claim_boundary: These are measurements from one base M4 MacBook Pro and the listed software. They do not predict performance on another Mac.

measurement.metric: CPU frame production at Minecraft.renderFrame(boolean) return; each interval includes the frame limiter.

interval_fields.intervals_gt_ms: Count of complete sampled intervals longer than the threshold.
interval_fields.sum_of_complete_intervals_gt_ms: Sum of whole interval durations over the threshold, in milliseconds; not time in excess of the threshold.

measurement.relative_outliers: Local abrupt intervals versus nearby frame-time baseline are separate from fixed 33/50/100 ms counts.

source_scan.method: Reviewed compact summary and decision JSON. Large raw frame CSVs, unrelated logs, JARs, shader/resource-pack archives, world saves, and runtimes are excluded.

profiles.status: Selected clean daily profile in the campaign receipt

settings.java: ARM64 Java 25, G1, 512 MiB initial / 4 GiB max heap

receipt.relative_outlier_note: Short isolated 23-30 ms intervals remain; the receipt does not quantify a separate local-outlier count.

profiles.interpretation: 120 FPS is a cap, not a locked rate. Short captures support about 84-119 CPU FPS across the tested scenes; they do not establish zero hitches or presentation latency.

profiles.status: Measured faster visual fallback; not final selected profile
profiles.interpretation: Higher measured CPU throughput at a softer internal resolution. The campaign preferred 75% for clarity and accepted 70-90 FPS travel.

profiles.status: Configured and briefly movement-checked; not a sustained route qualification
profiles.interpretation: Brief ordinary walk/strafe/jump/look only; 120 is a cap. No controlled route or long-run qualification.
R16 showed more distant terrain with about 13% lower uncapped jungle throughput than R12. It passed the 15-minute 60-cap test, with one interval above 33 ms.

experiment_families.scope: About 60 s savanna captures at 1920x1200 output; CPU frame-production metric.
experiment_families.interpretation: Presets and internal resolution differ. These only screened candidates; they are not visual-quality-normalized comparisons.

comparison.uncertainty: Small single-screen differences; not a causal or general performance claim.

experiment_families.status: G1 retained; ZGC advantage not established
experiment_families.interpretation: Differences are small and order/thermal uncertainty remains; campaign kept ARM64 Java 25 G1 and 512 MiB/4 GiB heap.

findings: R16 showed more nearby terrain and lower dense-jungle throughput.
R12/S8 kept simulation active in the selected 75% profile.
R20/S6 received only a brief movement check.
Longer shadows reduced dense-jungle headroom in one tested profile; no global optimum claimed.
Cloud-work elimination was slower by about 1.3% in matched ocean and 0.9% in a cloud-heavy sky sample.
Turning cloud reflections off raised one sample from 85.11 to 89.54 CPU FPS but reduced desired atmosphere.
An 80% internal-scale profile measured 79.72 ocean and 83.58 travel FPS versus 85.05 and 90.93 for repeated 75% controls.
First dynamic version produced a near-black daylight scene during resize and was rejected.
An exposure-history initialization guard fixed that visible reset in short checks.
Adaptive prototype lacked an in-route scale trace and quality preference; low-floor scale looked softer. Static 75% remained supported.
Complemetal 0.4.1 kept Iris/OpenGL as the visible shader renderer; no material shader-frame Metal ownership was demonstrated.
Its shaderless hybrid showed Metal presentations but was not shader gameplay.
A Prisma 26.3 preview hotfix measured 18.26 CPU FPS at native output in a short village screen.
Rockstar Shaders 1.0.0 measured 24.66 FPS at High/native scale and 25.63 FPS at Medium/0.58 scale in tested Overworld scenes; it did not pass the balanced profile gate.
MetalMC research did not yield a validated shader-quality replacement for the daily profile.
Distant Horizons rendered after a generation-off retry, but render errors and clean-gate failures blocked performance timing.
Solas pipeline initialization failed on tested macOS OpenGL 4.1 at a missing clear-texture function.

iris_depth_identity_v3.status: Source recipe provided; campaign runtime identity checks passed Overworld/Nether/End.

makeup_exposure_init.change: Use calculated exposure unchanged when previous exposure history is zero/nonpositive; keep temporal smoothing for positive previous exposure.
makeup_exposure_init.status: Modified pack used in selected profile; source patch provided, binary shader pack not included.

invalid.reason: A one-option GUI action reset other shader options, leaving settings mismatched; excluded from comparisons.

prepared_but_unmeasured.reason: Kernel existed locally but had no valid gameplay performance or visual acceptance run; no gain claim.

integrity_filters.stopping_rule: Reuse valid evidence. Reject incomplete, invalid, visually incorrect, or materially incomparable captures; stop after one visually acceptable profile passes representative scenes and clean handoff.
